name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-09-09, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
